newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium ends firmer in lacklustre trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium ends firmer in lacklustre trade.

text.p: Tokyo yen-based aluminium futures ended firmer in thin trade on Thursday, helped by the metal's small rise in London overnight, traders said.
"There's nothing to do," said one trader at a major trading house. "The metal rose slightly in London, but the dollar isn't moving at all."
Traders said prices tended to fluctuate easily as volume remained very thin.
The TOCOM benchmark April 1998 contract added 0.9 yen to end at 189.8 yen, while other contracts gained between 0.3 and 0.9 yen. Estimated volume was a thin 1,052 lots.
In London overnight, three months aluminium finished up $10 at $1,593 per tonne, led by gains in copper. -- Tokyo Commodities +81-3-3432-6179
